correctness.rationale: Conjugation by t+c t^j changes the j-th coefficient by c(a^j-a), allowing triangular elimination of all nonresonant jets. Resonant coefficients remain jointly uniform. In normal form only exponent multiples of d can be fixed; the first nonzero resonance at r shifts z^j by a nonzero j*gamma*z^(j+r) for 1<=j<=m-r because m<=p, exactly yielding the tail algebra. The exact geometric probabilities follow from independent resonant coefficients. The embedded checker exhaustively tests 38674 automorphisms in 10 prime and extension-field configurations, plus canonical fixed bases and a small-characteristic counterexample outside scope.
